newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-GREEK CHAMPIONS OLYMPIAKOS END SEASON WITH 6-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREEK CHAMPIONS OLYMPIAKOS END SEASON WITH 6-0 WIN.

text.p: Greek champions Olympiakos ended their best season in a decade with a 6-0 win over Kavala on Sunday in front of thousands of delirious fans who stormed the pitch in the second half to celebrate prematurely and held the game up for half an hour.
Club owner Socratis Kokkalis had to issue several warnings at the packed Karaiskaki stadium to persuade the fans to leave the pitch so that the last 20 minutes could be played.
The match restarted after about 30 minutes with the fans lining the perimeter and storming back to celebrate after the final whistle.

They tore apart the nets to keep as souvenirs and then gathered in front of the VIP stands where club captain Kyriakos Karataidis lifted the cup amid a spectacular firework display which lit up the sky.

"I feel very happy because after such a long time Olympiakos is back at the top," Kokkalis told reporters. "We will do whatever it takes to make Olympiakos a force in the Champions' League (European Cup)."

It was the first Greek soccer championship triumph in 10 years for Olympiakos, the most popular Greek sports club with millions of fans around the country. They ended the season with 84 points, 12 more than second-placed AEK.
It completed a great treble for the Piraeus club, who won the European clubs' basketball championship in Rome last month and secured their fifth successive Greek basketball championship last week.
